publicReleaseNotes: First public release of Balm: practice software for a US outpatient physical, occupational or speech therapy clinic with 1 to 10 practitioners, run on your own computer or your own Cloudflare account. Clinic setup with services, practitioners, reception and weekly hours; a day and week calendar with recurring series and drag to move; online booking at /book from real open times with a taken time refused; one-use intake links bound to the form version, with a form builder; email waitlist offers for canceled visits; PT, OT and speech note templates signed and locked by their author with signed addenda and 8-minute-rule CPT units; plans of care certified by the referring physician from a private link; a scribe that drafts unsigned notes with your own AI key; approved, numbered invoices with fixed bytes and payments recorded once per reference; cards on file, copays at check-in, pay links, statements and superbills through your own Stripe account; automatic email reminders with one-reply confirmation; secure patient messages; an append-only access audit; agent keys that only prepare work for a person to approve; Cliniko patient move-in with undo; and local and hosted backup and restore. Not in this release: insurance billing, live text messages, a patient portal, telehealth or other move-in sources. Back up first with rer export on your own computer or rer run backup:hosted for a hosted clinic. The checkout pins rer 0.2.43.
agentUpdateInstructions: First release; there is no earlier release to update from. New install: npx -y @runeditrun/rer dev just-every/run-balm (or rer setup just-every/run-balm --owner-email OWNER, then rer dev), which installs the pinned rer 0.2.43 and applies migrations 0001 to 0025 in order. A checkout that ran main before v0.1.0: back up first (on your own computer rer dev --stop and rer export --output exports/balm-before-0.1.0.rer; hosted, from the deploying checkout with its .rer folder and Cloudflare settings, rer run backup:hosted -- --environment NAME), then git pull and rer dev, or git pull and rer deploy for a hosted copy; migrations apply forward only and keep the clinic. rer export saves only the local clinic and refuses a hosted address; never use it for a hosted backup. Restore a .rer archive with rer import into a fresh checkout before setup, and a hosted SQL backup with rer run restore:hosted -- --input FILE before rer setup; populated copies are refused. Stripe, the scribe key, SendGrid or Resend mail and Twilio texting stay off until the owner adds their own keys; Balm on your own computer sends no email. Run rer verify before adopting.
